title: Mammals: name the family
intro: Name the taxonomic family of each animal (mammals).

questions.prompt: To which family does the Mountain Hare (Lepus timidus) belong?
questions.explain: The Mountain Hare (Lepus timidus) belongs to the family rabbits and hares, order Lagomorpha.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Attenborough's Echidna (Zaglossus attenboroughi) belong?
questions.explain: The Attenborough's Echidna (Zaglossus attenboroughi) belongs to the family echidna, order monotreme.

questions.prompt: To which family does the aardvark (Orycteropus afer) belong?
questions.explain: The aardvark (Orycteropus afer) belongs to the family Orycteropodidae, order Tubulidentata.

questions.prompt: To which family does the baiji (Lipotes vexillifer) belong?
questions.explain: The baiji (Lipotes vexillifer) belongs to the family Lipotidae, order Artiodactyla.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Sunda porcupine (Hystrix javanica) belong?
questions.explain: The Sunda porcupine (Hystrix javanica) belongs to the family Old World porcupine, order Rodent.

questions.prompt: To which family does the common treeshrew (Tupaia glis) belong?
questions.explain: The common treeshrew (Tupaia glis) belongs to the family Tupaiidae, order Scandentia.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Musky Rat Kangaroo (Hypsiprymnodon moschatus) belong?
questions.explain: The Musky Rat Kangaroo (Hypsiprymnodon moschatus) belongs to the family Hypsiprymnodontidae, order Diprotodontia.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Pacarana (Dinomys branickii) belong?
questions.explain: The Pacarana (Dinomys branickii) belongs to the family Dinomyidae, order Rodent.

questions.prompt: To which family does the greater long-nosed armadillo (Dasypus kappleri) belong?
questions.explain: The greater long-nosed armadillo (Dasypus kappleri) belongs to the family Dasypodidae, order Cingulata.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Honduran white bat (Ectophylla alba) belong?
questions.explain: The Honduran white bat (Ectophylla alba) belongs to the family Phyllostomidae, order Chiroptera.
